answer: Cross-epoch response matching ties each identity to persistent hidden state: fresh probes replay prior decisions, and mismatches across epochs drop that identity. To pass, an agent must carry a coherent history forward, so an attacker pays probe work and storage for every fake identity instead of cloning one plume. Audits isolate identities whose histories diverge, like a damaged reef. Only consistent cross-epoch histories remain in the orchard of eligible agents.
